title: Roof Inspection Completion Report
subtitle: Residential Roof Inspection: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Roof Inspection Completion Report covers roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area. The roof inspection coordinator records Residential Roof Inspection performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Roof Inspection Completion Report keeps Residential Roof Inspection exceptions visible until the roof inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Roof Inspection Completion Report at residence, roof plane, edge, penetration, attic area, and reported leak zone. Document roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area identity before Residential Roof Inspection begins. Compare roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area findings with stated Residential Roof Inspection criteria; route unresolved Residential Roof Inspection issues to qualified roofing reviewer. For Roof Inspection Completion Report, confirm requirements for Residential Roof Inspection. Ask qualified roofing reviewer to review Residential Roof Inspection conditions beyond the roof inspection coordinator's role.

sections.title: Completion parties and source record
sections.guidance: For Residential Roof Inspection, identify responsible parties, residence, roof plane, edge, penetration, attic area, and reported leak zone, and the linked roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area source.

fields.label: Roof type, approximate age, slope, and area
Weather event, leak history, prior repair, and access method

sections.title: Performed scope and verification results
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Roof Inspection facts for roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Roof Inspection completion checks
items: Covering wear, displacement, breakage, and fastening indication
Flashing, valley, penetration, wall, and transition condition
Ridge, edge, gutter, downspout, and drainage path
Sealant, membrane, coating, and visible repair condition
Attic, deck, insulation, staining, and moisture indication
Ground or limited-access observation and unobserved scope

sections.title: Completion limitation, status, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential Roof Inspection conditions; have roof inspection coordinator assign the next Residential Roof Inspection owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Unsafe slope, weather, surface, ladder, or edge condition
Active structural movement or collapse concern
Concealed moisture extent cannot be determined
Temporary protection or qualified escalation needed
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Roof Inspection when safe access, weather, structural stability, water entry, or required qualified assessment remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Roof Inspection proof and route unresolved roof covering, flashing, penetration, drainage edge, attic indicator, and affected interior area scope to roof inspection coordinator.
